)

func mappingExpectedTransportForTest(port uint16) [24]byte {
	return [24]byte{0x54, 0x72, 0x61, 0x50, 24, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, byte(port), byte(port >> 8), 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0}
}

func TestMappingNativeABIAndTransportOptions(t *testing.T) {
	var resource mappingNetResource
	offsets := []uintptr{unsafe.Offsetof(resource.Scope), unsafe.Offsetof(resource.Type), unsafe.Offsetof(resource.DisplayType), unsafe.Offsetof(resource.Usage), unsafe.Offsetof(resource.LocalName), unsafe.Offsetof(resource.RemoteName), unsafe.Offsetof(resource.Comment), unsafe.Offsetof(resource.Provider)}
	if err := checkMappingNativeABI(); err != nil || unsafe.Sizeof(resource) != 48 || unsafe.Alignof(resource) != 8 || !reflect.DeepEqual(offsets, []uintptr{0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 40}) {
		t.Fatalf("NETRESOURCEW layout differs from the Windows 64-bit ABI: offsets=%v error=%v", offsets, err)
	}
	for _, port := range []uint16{1, 15445, 65535} {
		encoded, err := mappingTransportOptions(port)
		if err != nil || encoded != mappingExpectedTransportForTest(port) {
			t.Fatalf("transport options lost TCP-only fields or zero padding: port=%d bytes=%x error=%v", port, encoded, err)
		}
	}
	if encoded, err := mappingTransportOptions(0); err == nil || encoded != [24]byte{} {
		t.Fatal("zero TCP port produced an option record")
	}
}

func mappingAssertUTF16Pointer(t *testing.T, pointer *uint16, expected string) {
	t.Helper()
	if pointer == nil {
		t.Fatal("native resource omitted a required string")
	}
	want := append(utf16.Encode([]rune(expected)), 0)
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(unsafe.Slice(pointer, len(want)), want) {
		t.Fatal("native resource changed a target string or its terminator")
	}
}

func TestMappingNativeCreateUsesExactSevenArguments(t *testing.T) {
	const local, remote, port = "Z:", `\\127.0.0.1\rfs-fixture`, uint16(15445)
	for _, status := range []uint32{0, 5, 997, 1201} {
		var calls []string
		ops := mappingNativeOps{
			FindAdd: func() error { calls = append(calls, "find"); return nil },
			Add: func(owner uintptr, resource *mappingNetResource, auth uintptr, authBytes, flags uint32, options []byte, optionBytes uint32) uint32 {
				calls = append(calls, "add")
				if owner != 0 || auth != 0 || authBytes != 0 || flags != 0x4000 || optionBytes != 24 || len(options) != 24 {
					t.Fatal("WNet4 changed its seven arguments, NULL authentication or integrity-only policy")
				}
				if resource == nil || resource.Scope != 0 || resource.Type != 1 || resource.DisplayType != 0 || resource.Usage != 0 || resource.Comment != nil || resource.Provider != nil {
					t.Fatal("WNet4 resource includes a provider, comment or unsupported flags")
				}
				mappingAssertUTF16Pointer(t, resource.LocalName, local)
				mappingAssertUTF16Pointer(t, resource.RemoteName, remote)
				want := mappingExpectedTransportForTest(port)
				if !bytes.Equal(options, want[:]) {
					t.Fatal("WNet4 did not receive the exact owned TCP port and option record")
				}
				return status
			},
		}
		invoked, code, err := mappingNativeCreate(local, remote, port, ops)
		if !invoked || code != status || err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(calls, []string{"find", "add"}) {
			t.Fatalf("native status was hidden or mutation replayed: invoked=%v status=%d calls=%v error=%v", invoked, code, calls, err)
		}
	}
	lookupFailure := errors.New("WNet4 export unavailable")
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name, local, remote string
		port                uint16
		findErr             error
		wantFind            int
	}{
		{"zero-port", local, remote, 0, nil, 0},
		{"local-nul", "Z:\x00", remote, port, nil, 0},
		{"remote-nul", local, remote + "\x00", port, nil, 0},
		{"missing-export", local, remote, port, lookupFailure, 1},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			finds, adds := 0, 0
			ops := mappingNativeOps{FindAdd: func() error { finds++; return test.findErr }, Add: func(uintptr, *mappingNetResource, uintptr, uint32, uint32, []byte, uint32) uint32 { adds++; return 0 }}
			invoked, code, err := mappingNativeCreate(test.local, test.remote, test.port, ops)
			if invoked || code != 0 || err == nil || finds != test.wantFind || adds != 0 || test.findErr != nil && !errors.Is(err, test.findErr) {
				t.Fatalf("invalid setup reached mutation or lost its cause: invoked=%v finds=%d adds=%d error=%v", invoked, finds, adds, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestMappingUTF16RejectsMalformedAndBoundsEncodedBytes(t *testing.T) {
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name  string
		words []uint16
		limit int
		want  string
		valid bool
	}{
		{"empty", nil, 1024, "", true},
		{"ascii", []uint16{'Z', ':'}, 2, "Z:", true},
		{"surrogate-pair", []uint16{0x6587, 0xd83e, 0xddea}, 7, "文🧪", true},
		{"utf8-bound", []uint16{0xd83e, 0xddea}, 3, "", false},
		{"high-only", []uint16{0xd83e}, 1024, "", false},
		{"low-only", []uint16{0xddea}, 1024, "", false},
		{"high-then-ascii", []uint16{0xd83e, 'x'}, 1024, "", false},
		{"valid-pair-then-low", []uint16{0xd83e, 0xddea, 0xddea}, 1024, "", false},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			value, err := mappingUTF16(test.words, test.limit)
			if (err == nil) != test.valid || value != test.want {
				t.Fatalf("UTF16 validity or byte bound changed: value=%q error=%v", value, err)
			}
		})
	}
	value := strings.Repeat("é", 512)
	if got, err := mappingUTF16(utf16.Encode([]rune(value)), 1024); err != nil || got != value {
		t.Fatal("exact UTF-8 byte limit was rejected")
	}
}

func mappingAlignedBufferForTest(size int) []byte {
	storage := make([]uint64, (size+7)/8)
	return unsafe.Slice((*byte)(unsafe.Pointer(&storage[0])), size)
}

func mappingResourcePageForTest(t *testing.T, buffer []byte, rows []mappingRow) int {
	t.Helper()
	offset := len(rows) * 48
	if offset > len(buffer) {
		t.Fatal("resource fixture exceeds header capacity")
	}
	clear(buffer[:offset])
	put := func(value string) uint64 {
		words := append(utf16.Encode([]rune(value)), 0)
		if offset+2*len(words) > len(buffer) {
			t.Fatal("resource fixture exceeds string capacity")
		}
		pointer := uint64(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&buffer[offset])))
		for _, word := range words {
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(buffer[offset:offset+2], word)
			offset += 2
		}
		return pointer
	}
	for index, row := range rows {
		header := buffer[index*48 : (index+1)*48]
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(header[4:8], 1)
		if row.LocalPath != "" {
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(header[16:24], put(row.LocalPath))
		}
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(header[24:32], put(row.RemotePath))
	}
	return offset
}

func TestMappingResourceParserCopiesOnlyBoundedNativeRows(t *testing.T) {
	want := []mappingRow{{LocalPath: "Z:", RemotePath: `\\server\文🧪`}, {RemotePath: `\\server\deviceless`}}
	buffer := mappingAlignedBufferForTest(4096)
	size := mappingResourcePageForTest(t, buffer, want)
	rows, err := parseMappingResources(buffer[:size], uint32(len(want)))
	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(rows, want) {
		t.Fatalf("bounded resources changed: rows=%v error=%v", rows, err)
	}
	clear(buffer)
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(rows, want) {
		t.Fatal("parsed names alias the reused enumeration buffer")
	}
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name   string
		mutate func([]byte) ([]byte, uint32)
	}{
		{"zero-count", func(b []byte) ([]byte, uint32) { return b, 0 }},
		{"over-count", func(b []byte) ([]byte, uint32) { return b, 129 }},
		{"truncated-array", func(b []byte) ([]byte, uint32) { return b[:47], 1 }},
		{"unaligned-array", func(b []byte) ([]byte, uint32) { return b[1:], 1 }},
		{"non-disk", func(b []byte) ([]byte, uint32) { binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(b[4:8], 2); return b, 1 }},
		{"missing-remote", func(b []byte) ([]byte, uint32) { binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(b[24:32], 0); return b, 1 }},
		{"before-buffer", func(b []byte) ([]byte, uint32) {
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(b[16:24], uint64(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&b[0]))-2))
			return b, 1
		}},
		{"after-buffer", func(b []byte) ([]byte, uint32) {
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(b[24:32], uint64(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&b[0]))+uintptr(len(b))))
			return b, 1
		}},
		{"unaligned-string", func(b []byte) ([]byte, uint32) {
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(b[16:24], uint64(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&b[49]))))
			return b, 1
		}},
		{"unterminated", func(b []byte) ([]byte, uint32) {
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(b[24:32], uint64(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&b[len(b)-2]))))
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(b[len(b)-2:], 'x')
			return b, 1
		}},
		{"empty-remote", func(b []byte) ([]byte, uint32) {
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(b[24:32], uint64(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&b[len(b)-2]))))
			return b, 1
		}},
		{"invalid-surrogate", func(b []byte) ([]byte, uint32) {
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(b[24:32], uint64(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&b[len(b)-4]))))
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(b[len(b)-4:], 0xd83e)
			return b, 1
		}},
		{"pointer-beyond-returned-size", func(b []byte) ([]byte, uint32) { return b[:48], 1 }},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			buffer := mappingAlignedBufferForTest(256)
			mappingResourcePageForTest(t, buffer, want[:1])
			changed, count := test.mutate(buffer)
			if rows, err := parseMappingResources(changed, count); err == nil || rows != nil {
				t.Fatal("malformed native resource page became a complete inventory")
			}
		})
	}
	for _, name := range []string{strings.Repeat("x", 1025), strings.Repeat("é", 513)} {
		buffer := mappingAlignedBufferForTest(4096)
		size := mappingResourcePageForTest(t, buffer, []mappingRow{{RemotePath: name}})
		if rows, err := parseMappingResources(buffer[:size], 1); err == nil || rows != nil {
			t.Fatal("resource field exceeded its UTF-8 byte limit")
		}
	}
	if value, err := mappingBufferString(nil, 0, false); err != nil || value != "" {
		t.Fatal("optional null local name was rejected")
	}
	if _, err := mappingBufferString(nil, 0, true); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("required null remote name was accepted")
	}
}

func TestMappingEnumerationCompletesWithinFixedBounds(t *testing.T) {
	for _, pageSize := range []int{1, 128} {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("page-size-%d", pageSize), func(t *testing.T) {
			calls, closes, emitted := 0, 0, 0
			ops := mappingNativeOps{
				OpenEnum: func() (uintptr, uint32) { return 77, 0 },
				Enum: func(handle uintptr, buffer []byte, count, size *uint32) uint32 {
					calls++
					if handle != 77 || len(buffer) != 1<<20 || *size != uint32(len(buffer)) || uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&buffer[0]))%8 != 0 || *count != uint32(max(1, 128-emitted)) {
						t.Fatal("enumeration changed handle, aligned fixed-byte capacity or nonzero terminal count")
					}
					if emitted == 128 {
						*count, *size = ^uint32(0), ^uint32(0)
						clear(buffer)
						return 259
					}
					page := make([]mappingRow, pageSize)
					for index := range page {
						page[index].RemotePath = fmt.Sprintf(`\\server\share-%d`, emitted+index)
					}
					*count = uint32(len(page))
					*size = uint32(mappingResourcePageForTest(t, buffer, page))
					emitted += len(page)
					return 0
				},
				CloseEnum: func(handle uintptr) uint32 {
					closes++
					if handle != 77 {
						t.Fatal("enumeration closed a different handle")
					}
					return 0
				},
			}
			rows, err := enumerateMappings(ops)
			if err != nil || len(rows) != 128 || calls != 128/pageSize+1 || closes != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("complete bounded enumeration changed: rows=%d calls=%d closes=%d error=%v", len(rows), calls, closes, err)
			}
			for index, row := range rows {
				if row.LocalPath != "" || row.RemotePath != fmt.Sprintf(`\\server\share-%d`, index) {
					t.Fatal("later enumeration pages overwrote earlier observations")
				}
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestMappingEnumerationFailuresNeverBecomeEmptyOrPartialSuccess(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"empty", "open-error", "more-data", "after-page-error", "no-progress", "over-count", "over-size", "returned-header-only", "129th-entry", "close-error", "query-and-close-error"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			calls, closes := 0, 0
			ops := mappingNativeOps{
				OpenEnum: func() (uintptr, uint32) {
					if mode == "open-error" {
						return 99, 5
					}
					return 77, 0
				},
				Enum: func(_ uintptr, buffer []byte, count, size *uint32) uint32 {
					calls++
					if mode == "empty" || mode == "close-error" {
						*count, *size = ^uint32(0), ^uint32(0)
						return 259
					}
					if mode == "more-data" || mode == "query-and-close-error" || mode == "after-page-error" && calls > 1 {
						*count, *size = ^uint32(0), ^uint32(0)
						return 234
					}
					if mode == "no-progress" {
						*count = 0
						return 0
					}
					if mode == "over-count" {
						*count = 129
						return 0
					}
					if mode == "over-size" {
						*count, *size = 1, uint32(len(buffer)+1)
						return 0
					}
					page := []mappingRow{{RemotePath: `\\server\share`}}
					if mode == "129th-entry" && calls == 1 {
						page = make([]mappingRow, 128)
						for index := range page {
							page[index].RemotePath = `\\server\share`
						}
					}
					*count = uint32(len(page))
					*size = uint32(mappingResourcePageForTest(t, buffer, page))
					if mode == "returned-header-only" {
						*size = 48
					}
					return 0
				},
				CloseEnum: func(uintptr) uint32 {
					closes++
					if mode == "close-error" || mode == "query-and-close-error" {
						return 6
					}
					return 0
				},
			}
			rows, err := enumerateMappings(ops)
			if mode == "empty" {
				if err != nil || rows == nil || len(rows) != 0 || calls != 1 || closes != 1 {
					t.Fatal("NO_MORE_ITEMS without prior rows did not prove an empty completed enumeration")
				}
				return
			}
			wantClosed := 1
			if mode == "open-error" {
				wantClosed = 0
			}
			if err == nil || closes != wantClosed || mode != "close-error" && rows != nil || calls > 129 {
				t.Fatalf("incomplete enumeration became success or leaked its handle: calls=%d closes=%d rows=%v error=%v", calls, closes, rows, err)
			}
			if mode == "query-and-close-error" && (!strings.Contains(err.Error(), "234") || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "6")) {
				t.Fatal("enumeration cleanup replaced the original API failure")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestMappingLookupKeepsStatusAndCharacterBounds(t *testing.T) {
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name   string
		status uint32
		value  string
		mutate func([]uint16, *uint32)
		valid  bool
	}{
		{name: "connected", value: `\\server\文🧪`, valid: true},
		{name: "exact-byte-bound", value: strings.Repeat("é", 512), valid: true},
		{name: "not-connected", status: 2250, valid: true},
		{name: "unavailable", status: 1201, valid: true},
		{name: "more-data", status: 234},
		{name: "access-denied", status: 5},
		{name: "empty-success"},
		{name: "byte-overflow", value: strings.Repeat("é", 513)},
		{name: "capacity-overflow", value: "remote", mutate: func(_ []uint16, size *uint32) { *size = 1026 }},
		{name: "unterminated", mutate: func(buffer []uint16, _ *uint32) {
			for index := range buffer {
				buffer[index] = 'x'
			}
		}},
		{name: "invalid-surrogate", mutate: func(buffer []uint16, _ *uint32) { buffer[0] = 0xd83e }},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			calls := 0
			ops := mappingNativeOps{Connection: func(drive string, buffer []uint16, size *uint32) uint32 {
				calls++
				if drive != "Z:" || len(buffer) != 1025 || *size != 1025 {
					t.Fatal("lookup confused character and byte capacities or changed the drive")
				}
				if test.status != 0 {
					buffer[0], *size = 0xd83e, ^uint32(0)
				} else {
					words := append(utf16.Encode([]rune(test.value)), 0)
					copy(buffer, words)
					*size = uint32(len(words))
				}
				if test.mutate != nil {
					test.mutate(buffer, size)
				}
				return test.status
			}}
			connection, err := mappingLookup("Z:", ops)
			if (err == nil) != test.valid || calls != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("lookup status or bound changed: result=%+v error=%v calls=%d", connection, err, calls)
			}
			if test.valid && (connection.Status != test.status || connection.RemotePath != test.value) {
				t.Fatal("lookup invented a remote name or collapsed unavailable into absent")
			}
		})
	}
}

func cloneMappingValue[T any](t *testing.T, value T) T {
	t.Helper()
	data, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var result T
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &result); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return result
}

func mappingOwnerForTest() mappingOwner {
	return mappingOwner{SID: "S-1-5-21-10-20-30-1001", AuthenticationID: "0000000000000123", WindowsBuild: 26100}
}

func mappingBaselineForTest() mappingSnapshot {
	snapshot := mappingSnapshot{Owner: mappingOwnerForTest(), Rows: []mappingRow{{LocalPath: "M:", RemotePath: `\\baseline\share`}}, Connections: map[string]mappingConnection{}, Devices: map[string][]string{}, LogicalDrives: 1<<2 | 1<<12}
	for letter := 'A'; letter <= 'Z'; letter++ {
		drive := string(letter) + ":"
		snapshot.Connections[drive] = mappingConnection{Status: 2250}
		snapshot.Devices[drive] = nil
	}
	snapshot.Connections["M:"] = mappingConnection{RemotePath: `\\baseline\share`}
	snapshot.Devices["C:"] = []string{`\Device\HarddiskVolume4`}
	snapshot.Devices["M:"] = []string{"baseline opaque mapping"}
	return snapshot
}

func TestMappingDriveSelectionRequiresAllNativeInventories(t *testing.T) {
	snapshot := mappingBaselineForTest()
	snapshot.LogicalDrives |= 1 << 25
	snapshot.Connections["Y:"] = mappingConnection{Status: 1201}
	snapshot.Rows = append(snapshot.Rows, mappingRow{LocalPath: "X:", RemotePath: `\\another\share`})
	snapshot.Connections["X:"] = mappingConnection{RemotePath: `\\another\share`}
	snapshot.Devices["W:"] = []string{"occupied DOS drive"}
	if drive, err := chooseMappingDrive(snapshot); err != nil || drive != "V:" {
		t.Fatalf("drive selection ignored a native occupancy fact: drive=%q error=%v", drive, err)
	}
	snapshot.LogicalDrives = (1 << 26) - 1
	if _, err := chooseMappingDrive(snapshot); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("occupied drives produced a free candidate")
	}
	for _, change := range []func(*mappingSnapshot){
		func(s *mappingSnapshot) { delete(s.Connections, "A:") },
		func(s *mappingSnapshot) { delete(s.Devices, "A:") },
		func(s *mappingSnapshot) { s.Connections["Z:"] = mappingConnection{Status: 5} },
		func(s *mappingSnapshot) { s.Connections["Z:"] = mappingConnection{} },
		func(s *mappingSnapshot) {
			s.Connections["Z:"] = mappingConnection{Status: 1201, RemotePath: "invented"}
		},
		func(s *mappingSnapshot) { s.Connections["M:"] = mappingConnection{RemotePath: `\\foreign\share`} },
		func(s *mappingSnapshot) { s.Rows = append(s.Rows, s.Rows[0]) },
		func(s *mappingSnapshot) { s.LogicalDrives |= 1 << 31 },
		func(s *mappingSnapshot) { s.Owner.AuthenticationID = "" },
	} {
		value := cloneMappingValue(t, mappingBaselineForTest())
		change(&value)
		if _, err := chooseMappingDrive(value); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("incomplete or inconsistent inventory authorized a new mapping")
		}
	}
}

func mappingSnapshotOpsForTest(t *testing.T, snapshot mappingSnapshot) mappingNativeOps {
	t.Helper()
	page := 0
	return mappingNativeOps{
		OpenEnum: func() (uintptr, uint32) { page = 0; return 77, 0 },
		Enum: func(_ uintptr, buffer []byte, count, size *uint32) uint32 {
			page++
			if page > 1 || len(snapshot.Rows) == 0 {
				return 259
			}
			*count = uint32(len(snapshot.Rows))
			*size = uint32(mappingResourcePageForTest(t, buffer, snapshot.Rows))
			return 0
		},
		CloseEnum: func(uintptr) uint32 { return 0 },
		Connection: func(drive string, buffer []uint16, size *uint32) uint32 {
			connection, ok := snapshot.Connections[drive]
			if !ok {
				t.Fatal("native snapshot queried an unexpected local drive")
			}
			if connection.Status == 0 {
				words := append(utf16.Encode([]rune(connection.RemotePath)), 0)
				copy(buffer, words)
				*size = uint32(len(words))
			}
			return connection.Status
		},
		DOS:           func(drive string) ([]string, error) { return append([]string(nil), snapshot.Devices[drive]...), nil },
		LogicalDrives: func() (uint32, error) { return snapshot.LogicalDrives, nil },
	}
}

func TestNativeMappingSnapshotRequiresEverySuccessfulObservation(t *testing.T) {
	want := mappingBaselineForTest()
	want.Connections["Y:"] = mappingConnection{Status: 1201}
	ops := mappingSnapshotOpsForTest(t, want)
	lookup, dos, logical := ops.Connection, ops.DOS, ops.LogicalDrives
	lookupCalls, dosCalls := map[string]int{}, map[string]int{}
	logicalCalls := 0
	ops.Connection = func(drive string, buffer []uint16, size *uint32) uint32 {
		lookupCalls[drive]++
		return lookup(drive, buffer, size)
	}
	ops.DOS = func(drive string) ([]string, error) { dosCalls[drive]++; return dos(drive) }
	ops.LogicalDrives = func() (uint32, error) { logicalCalls++; return logical() }
	got, err := nativeMappingSnapshot(want.Owner, ops)
	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) || logicalCalls != 1 || len(lookupCalls) != 26 || len(dosCalls) != 26 {
		t.Fatalf("snapshot lost complete native facts: error=%v lookup=%d DOS=%d logical=%d", err, len(lookupCalls), len(dosCalls), logicalCalls)
	}
	for letter := 'A'; letter <= 'Z'; letter++ {
		drive := string(letter) + ":"
		if lookupCalls[drive] != 1 || dosCalls[drive] != 1 {
			t.Fatal("snapshot repeated or omitted a drive observation")
		}
	}
	failure := errors.New("native inventory failed")
	for _, phase := range []string{"enumeration", "lookup", "DOS", "logical", "disagreement"} {
		t.Run(phase, func(t *testing.T) {
			ops := mappingSnapshotOpsForTest(t, want)
			switch phase {
			case "enumeration":
				ops.OpenEnum = func() (uintptr, uint32) { return 0, 5 }
			case "lookup":
				ops.Connection = func(string, []uint16, *uint32) uint32 { return 5 }
			case "DOS":
				ops.DOS = func(string) ([]string, error) { return nil, failure }
			case "logical":
				ops.LogicalDrives = func() (uint32, error) { return 0, failure }
			case "disagreement":
				ops.Connection = func(string, []uint16, *uint32) uint32 { return 2250 }
			}
			_, err := nativeMappingSnapshot(want.Owner, ops)
			if err == nil || (phase == "DOS" || phase == "logical") && !errors.Is(err, failure) {
				t.Fatalf("failed observation became an authoritative snapshot: %v", err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func mappingRequestForTest(t *testing.T, action string) mappingCommandRequest {
	t.Helper()
	state, err := filepath.Abs(filepath.Join("native-mapping-fixture", "windows-runs", "123-1", "evidence", "probe-state.json"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	request := mappingCommandRequest{Version: 1, Action: action, RunID: "123-1", SourceSHA: strings.Repeat("a", 40), Nonce: strings.Repeat("b", 64), Volume: fixtureVolume, Sequence: 2, StateFile: state, Owner: mappingOwnerForTest()}
	if action != "inventory" {
		request.LocalPath, request.RemotePath, request.TCPPort = "Z:", `\\127.0.0.1\rfs-`+request.Nonce, 15445
	}
	return request
}

func mappingRequestFrameForTest(t *testing.T, request mappingCommandRequest) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	data, err := json.Marshal(request)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return append(data, '\n')
}

func mappingLedgerForRequestForTest(request mappingCommandRequest) mappingLedger {
	ledger := mappingLedger{Version: 2, RunID: request.RunID, SourceSHA: request.SourceSHA, Nonce: request.Nonce, Volume: request.Volume, Sequence: request.Sequence, Owner: request.Owner, LocalPath: request.LocalPath, RemotePath: request.RemotePath, TCPPort: request.TCPPort, Transport: "TCP", RequireIntegrity: true, State: "intent", Baseline: mappingBaselineForTest(), CreateOutcome: mappingMutation{Knowledge: "pending"}, RemoveOutcome: mappingMutation{Knowledge: "none"}}
	if request.Action == "remove" {
		code := uint32(0)
		ledger.State = "remove-pending"
		ledger.CreateOutcome = mappingMutation{Knowledge: "returned", Code: &code, HelperQuiesced: true}
		ledger.RemoveOutcome = mappingMutation{Knowledge: "pending"}
		ledger.ObservedRow = &mappingRow{LocalPath: request.LocalPath, RemotePath: request.RemotePath}
		ledger.ObservedDevice = []string{"owned native target"}
	}
	return ledger
}

func mappingSnapshotForRequestForTest(request mappingCommandRequest) mappingSnapshot {
	snapshot := mappingBaselineForTest()
	if request.Action == "remove" {
		snapshot.Rows = append(snapshot.Rows, mappingRow{LocalPath: request.LocalPath, RemotePath: request.RemotePath})
		snapshot.Connections[request.LocalPath] = mappingConnection{RemotePath: request.RemotePath}
		snapshot.Devices[request.LocalPath] = []string{"owned native target"}
		snapshot.LogicalDrives |= 1 << uint(request.LocalPath[0]-'A')
	}
	return snapshot
}

type mappingOpenFrameReader struct {
	data  []byte
	reads int
}

func (r *mappingOpenFrameReader) Read(buffer []byte) (int, error) {
	r.reads++
	if len(r.data) == 0 {
		return 0, errors.New("helper waited for stdin EOF")
	}
	n := copy(buffer, r.data)
	r.data = r.data[n:]
	return n, nil
}

func TestNativeMappingHelperUsesOneBoundFrameAndExactOperations(t *testing.T) {
	for _, action := range []string{"inventory", "create", "remove"} {
		t.Run(action, func(t *testing.T) {
			request := mappingRequestForTest(t, action)
			frame := mappingRequestFrameForTest(t, request)
			input := &mappingOpenFrameReader{data: frame}
			var output bytes.Buffer
			var order []string
			ops := mappingSnapshotOpsForTest(t, mappingSnapshotForRequestForTest(request))
			ops.FindAdd = func() error { order = append(order, "find"); return nil }
			ops.Add = func(_ uintptr, resource *mappingNetResource, _ uintptr, _, _ uint32, _ []byte, _ uint32) uint32 {
				order = append(order, "create")
				mappingAssertUTF16Pointer(t, resource.LocalName, request.LocalPath)
				mappingAssertUTF16Pointer(t, resource.RemoteName, request.RemotePath)
				return 0
			}
			ops.Cancel = func(local string, flags uint32, force bool) uint32 {
				order = append(order, "remove")
				if local != request.LocalPath || flags != 0 || force {
					t.Fatal("removal became remote-wide, persistent or forced")
				}
				return 0
			}
			services := mappingHelperServices{
				Owner: func() (mappingOwner, error) { order = append(order, "owner"); return request.Owner, nil },
				Job:   func() error { order = append(order, "job"); return nil },
				Authorize: func(actual mappingCommandRequest) (mappingLedger, error) {
					order = append(order, "authorize")
					if !reflect.DeepEqual(actual, request) {
						t.Fatal("helper authorization lost request or state-file identity")
					}
					return mappingLedgerForRequestForTest(request), nil
				},
				Native: ops,
			}
			if err := runMappingHelperWith(nil, input, &output, services); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			result, err := validateMappingResult(output.Bytes(), request)
			if err != nil || result.RequestSHA256 != fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(frame)) || result.Owner != request.Owner || result.OwnerAfter == nil || *result.OwnerAfter != request.Owner || input.reads != 1 || bytes.Count(output.Bytes(), []byte{'\n'}) != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("helper frame/owner binding changed: result=%+v reads=%d error=%v", result, input.reads, err)
			}
			wantOrder := []string{"owner", "job", "authorize"}
			if action == "inventory" {
				if result.Knowledge != "inventory" || result.APIStatus != nil || result.Snapshot == nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(*result.Snapshot, mappingBaselineForTest()) {
					t.Fatal("inventory result lacks actual complete native facts")
				}
			} else {
				if action == "create" {
					wantOrder = append(wantOrder, "find")
				}
				wantOrder = append(wantOrder, action)
				if result.Knowledge != "returned" || result.APIStatus == nil || *result.APIStatus != 0 || result.Snapshot != nil {
					t.Fatal("mutation acknowledgement invented inventory or omitted call-return knowledge")
				}
			}
			wantOrder = append(wantOrder, "owner")
			if !reflect.DeepEqual(order, wantOrder) {
				t.Fatalf("helper ownership/admission order changed: %v", order)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestNativeMappingHelperRejectsMalformedRequestsBeforeOwnership(t *testing.T) {
	request := mappingRequestForTest(t, "create")
	frame := mappingRequestFrameForTest(t, request)
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name  string
		args  []string
		frame []byte
	}{
		{"arguments", []string{"extra"}, frame},
		{"missing-frame", nil, nil},
		{"missing-LF", nil, frame[:len(frame)-1]},
		{"over-bound", nil, append(bytes.Repeat([]byte{'x'}, 4096), '\n')},
		{"duplicate-key", nil, bytes.Replace(frame, []byte(`"version":1`), []byte(`"version":1,"version":1`), 1)},
		{"unknown-field", nil, bytes.Replace(frame, []byte(`"version":1`), []byte(`"version":1,"extra":true`), 1)},
		{"second-JSON-value", nil, append(append([]byte(nil), frame[:len(frame)-1]...), []byte("{}\n")...)},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			owners := 0
			var output bytes.Buffer
			services := mappingHelperServices{Owner: func() (mappingOwner, error) { owners++; return mappingOwner{}, errors.New("unexpected owner lookup") }}
			if err := runMappingHelperWith(test.args, bytes.NewReader(test.frame), &output, services); err == nil || owners != 0 || output.Len() != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("malformed request reached ownership or generated a reply: owners=%d bytes=%d error=%v", owners, output.Len(), err)
			}
		})
	}
	for _, mutate := range []func(*mappingCommandRequest){
		func(r *mappingCommandRequest) { r.Version = 2 },
		func(r *mappingCommandRequest) { r.Action = "other" },
		func(r *mappingCommandRequest) { r.Sequence = 0 },
		func(r *mappingCommandRequest) { r.SourceSHA = strings.Repeat("A", 40) },
		func(r *mappingCommandRequest) { r.Nonce = "short" },
		func(r *mappingCommandRequest) { r.Volume = "foreign" },
		func(r *mappingCommandRequest) { r.Owner.AuthenticationID = "" },
		func(r *mappingCommandRequest) { r.Owner.SID = "foreign" },
		func(r *mappingCommandRequest) { r.LocalPath = "C:" },
		func(r *mappingCommandRequest) { r.RemotePath = `\\foreign\share` },
		func(r *mappingCommandRequest) { r.TCPPort = 0 },
		func(r *mappingCommandRequest) { r.Action = "inventory" },
	} {
		value := request
		mutate(&value)
		if err := validateMappingRequest(value); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("invalid helper request identity or target was accepted")
		}
	}
}

func TestNativeMappingHelperGuardsAndRawFailureStatus(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"owner-error", "foreign-SID", "foreign-logon", "job", "authorize", "occupied", "missing-export", "API-error", "owner-after-error", "owner-after-change"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			request := mappingRequestForTest(t, "create")
			failure := errors.New("injected helper failure")
			current := mappingSnapshotForRequestForTest(request)
			if mode == "occupied" {
				current.Connections[request.LocalPath] = mappingConnection{Status: 1201}
			}
			ops := mappingSnapshotOpsForTest(t, current)
			calls, owners := 0, 0
			ops.FindAdd = func() error {
				if mode == "missing-export" {
					return failure
				}
				return nil
			}
			ops.Add = func(uintptr, *mappingNetResource, uintptr, uint32, uint32, []byte, uint32) uint32 {
				calls++
				if mode == "API-error" {
					return 5
				}
				return 0
			}
			services := mappingHelperServices{
				Owner: func() (mappingOwner, error) {
					owners++
					owner := request.Owner
					if mode == "owner-error" || mode == "owner-after-error" && owners > 1 {
						return mappingOwner{}, failure
					}
					if mode == "foreign-SID" || mode == "owner-after-change" && owners > 1 {
						owner.SID = "S-1-5-21-10-20-30-2002"
					}
					if mode == "foreign-logon" {
						owner.AuthenticationID = "0000000000000999"
					}
					return owner, nil
				},
				Job: func() error {
					if mode == "job" {
						return failure
					}
					return nil
				},
				Authorize: func(mappingCommandRequest) (mappingLedger, error) {
					if mode == "authorize" {
						return mappingLedger{}, failure
					}
					return mappingLedgerForRequestForTest(request), nil
				},
				Native: ops,
			}
			var output bytes.Buffer
			err := runMappingHelperWith(nil, bytes.NewReader(mappingRequestFrameForTest(t, request)), &output, services)
			invoked := mode == "API-error" || strings.HasPrefix(mode, "owner-after-")
			wantCalls := 0
			if invoked {
				wantCalls = 1
			}
			if err == nil || calls != wantCalls {
				t.Fatalf("helper guard or mutation count changed: calls=%d error=%v", calls, err)
			}
			if mode == "owner-error" || mode == "job" || mode == "authorize" || mode == "missing-export" || mode == "owner-after-error" {
				if !errors.Is(err, failure) {
					t.Fatalf("helper lost its original failure: %v", err)
				}
			}
			var result mappingCommandResult
			if err := json.Unmarshal(output.Bytes(), &result); err != nil || result.Cause == "" || result.Snapshot != nil {
				t.Fatal("failed helper invented inventory or omitted its failure")
			}
			if invoked {
				if result.Knowledge != "returned" || result.APIStatus == nil || mode == "API-error" && *result.APIStatus != 5 {
					t.Fatal("helper replaced an observed API return with invented non-invocation")
				}
			} else if result.Knowledge != "not-invoked" || result.APIStatus != nil {
				t.Fatal("refused helper fabricated a native call result")
			}
			if mode == "API-error" {
				if _, err := validateMappingResult(output.Bytes(), request); err != nil {
					t.Fatal("complete bound failure reply lost its call-return knowledge")
				}
			}
			if mode == "foreign-SID" || mode == "foreign-logon" || strings.HasPrefix(mode, "owner-after-") {
				if _, err := validateMappingResult(output.Bytes(), request); err == nil {
					t.Fatal("changed or unknown actual owner supplied trusted mutation knowledge")
				}
			}
		})
	}
}

func mappingResultFrameForTest(t *testing.T, result mappingCommandResult) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	data, err := json.Marshal(result)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return append(data, '\n')
}

func mappingReturnedResultForTest(t *testing.T, request mappingCommandRequest, status uint32) mappingCommandResult {
	t.Helper()
	after := request.Owner
	result := mappingCommandResult{Version: 1, RequestSHA256: fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(mappingRequestFrameForTest(t, request))), Action: request.Action, Owner: request.Owner, OwnerAfter: &after, Knowledge: "returned", APIStatus: &status, Requested: mappingRequestedAPI(request)}
	if status != 0 {
		result.Cause = fmt.Sprintf("native API status %d", status)
	}
	return result
}

func TestNativeMappingReplyRequiresCompleteBoundOperationFacts(t *testing.T) {
	request := mappingRequestForTest(t, "create")
	valid := mappingReturnedResultForTest(t, request, 0)
	frame := mappingResultFrameForTest(t, valid)
	if _, err := validateMappingResult(frame, request); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, mutate := range []func(*mappingCommandResult){
		func(r *mappingCommandResult) { r.Version = 0 },
		func(r *mappingCommandResult) { r.RequestSHA256 = strings.Repeat("c", 64) },
		func(r *mappingCommandResult) { r.Action = "remove" },
		func(r *mappingCommandResult) { r.Owner.AuthenticationID = "0000000000000999" },
		func(r *mappingCommandResult) { r.OwnerAfter = nil },
		func(r *mappingCommandResult) { r.OwnerAfter.SID = "S-1-5-21-10-20-30-2002" },
		func(r *mappingCommandResult) { r.Knowledge = "unknown" },
		func(r *mappingCommandResult) { r.APIStatus = nil },
		func(r *mappingCommandResult) { snapshot := mappingBaselineForTest(); r.Snapshot = &snapshot },
		func(r *mappingCommandResult) { code := uint32(5); r.APIStatus = &code },
		func(r *mappingCommandResult) { r.Cause = strings.Repeat("x", 1025) },
		func(r *mappingCommandResult) { r.Requested.Name = "WNetAddConnection2W" },
		func(r *mappingCommandResult) { r.Requested.Flags = 0 },
		func(r *mappingCommandResult) { r.Requested.AuthBytes = 1 },
		func(r *mappingCommandResult) { r.Requested.Force = true },
		func(r *mappingCommandResult) { r.Requested.TransportOptionsHex = "" },
	} {
		result := cloneMappingValue(t, valid)
		mutate(&result)
		if _, err := validateMappingResult(mappingResultFrameForTest(t, result), request); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("foreign or contradictory mutation facts were accepted")
		}
	}
	for _, invalid := range [][]byte{
		nil, frame[:len(frame)-1], append(append([]byte(nil), frame...), '\n'), append(append([]byte(nil), frame...), frame...),
		bytes.Replace(frame, []byte(`"version":1`), []byte(`"version":1,"version":1`), 1),
		bytes.Replace(frame, []byte(`"version":1`), []byte(`"version":1,"extra":true`), 1),
	} {
		if _, err := validateMappingResult(invalid, request); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("partial, duplicate or additional reply data supplied operation knowledge")
		}
	}
	for _, status := range []uint32{5, 997, 1201} {
		result := mappingReturnedResultForTest(t, request, status)
		got, err := validateMappingResult(mappingResultFrameForTest(t, result), request)
		if err != nil || got.APIStatus == nil || *got.APIStatus != status || got.Knowledge != "returned" {
			t.Fatal("nonzero returned status was erased or treated as absence")
		}
	}
	notInvoked := cloneMappingValue(t, valid)
	notInvoked.Knowledge, notInvoked.APIStatus, notInvoked.OwnerAfter, notInvoked.Cause = "not-invoked", nil, nil, "admission refused"
	if _, err := validateMappingResult(mappingResultFrameForTest(t, notInvoked), request); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("bound pre-dispatch refusal lost its explicit knowledge")
	}
	for _, mutate := range []func(*mappingCommandResult){
		func(r *mappingCommandResult) { code := uint32(0); r.APIStatus = &code },
		func(r *mappingCommandResult) { r.Cause = "" },
		func(r *mappingCommandResult) { snapshot := mappingBaselineForTest(); r.Snapshot = &snapshot },
	} {
		result := cloneMappingValue(t, notInvoked)
		mutate(&result)
		if _, err := validateMappingResult(mappingResultFrameForTest(t, result), request); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("contradictory not-invoked reply was trusted")
		}
	}
	inventoryRequest := mappingRequestForTest(t, "inventory")
	inventoryError := mappingReturnedResultForTest(t, inventoryRequest, 0)
	inventoryError.Knowledge, inventoryError.APIStatus, inventoryError.Cause = "inventory-error", nil, "inventory failed"
	if got, err := validateMappingResult(mappingResultFrameForTest(t, inventoryError), inventoryRequest); err != nil || got.Snapshot != nil {
		t.Fatal("failed inventory was replaced by invented empty rows")
	}
}

func TestNativeMappingZeroAndEmptyFieldsRemainRequired(t *testing.T) {
	request := mappingRequestForTest(t, "inventory")
	for _, field := range []string{"local_path", "remote_path", "tcp_port"} {
		for _, null := range []bool{false, true} {
			var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
			if err := json.Unmarshal(mappingRequestFrameForTest(t, request), &fields); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			delete(fields, field)
			if null {
				fields[field] = json.RawMessage("null")
			}
			data, err := json.Marshal(fields)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			owners := 0
			services := mappingHelperServices{Owner: func() (mappingOwner, error) { owners++; return mappingOwner{}, errors.New("unexpected owner query") }}
			if err := runMappingHelperWith(nil, bytes.NewReader(append(data, '\n')), io.Discard, services); err == nil || owners != 0 {
				t.Fatal("missing/null inventory field was silently supplied by Go's zero value")
			}
		}
	}
	remove := mappingRequestForTest(t, "remove")
	result := mappingReturnedResultForTest(t, remove, 0)
	for _, field := range []string{"flags", "auth_bytes", "force", "transport_options_hex"} {
		for _, null := range []bool{false, true} {
			var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
			if err := json.Unmarshal(mappingResultFrameForTest(t, result), &fields); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			var requested map[string]json.RawMessage
			if err := json.Unmarshal(fields["requested_api"], &requested); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			delete(requested, field)
			if null {
				requested[field] = json.RawMessage("null")
			}
			var err error
			fields["requested_api"], err = json.Marshal(requested)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			data, err := json.Marshal(fields)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if _, err := validateMappingResult(append(data, '\n'), remove); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("missing/null native option became a trusted zero/empty observation")
			}
		}
	}
}

type mappingMemoryStore struct {
	t                  *testing.T
	o                  options
	ledger             mappingLedger
	events             *[]string
	created            bool
	createErr          error
	saveErrAt, saves   int
	publishBeforeError bool
}

func (s *mappingMemoryStore) Create(ledger mappingLedger) error {
	*s.events = append(*s.events, "intent")
	if s.created {
		return os.ErrExist
	}
	if s.createErr != nil {
		return s.createErr
	}
	if err := validateMappingLedger(ledger, s.o); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.created, s.ledger = true, cloneMappingValue(s.t, ledger)
	return nil
}

func (s *mappingMemoryStore) Save(ledger mappingLedger) error {
	s.saves++
	*s.events = append(*s.events, "save:"+ledger.State)
	if err := validateMappingLedger(ledger, s.o); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	failed := s.saves == s.saveErrAt
	if !failed || s.publishBeforeError {
		s.ledger = cloneMappingValue(s.t, ledger)
	}
	if failed {
		return syscall.EIO
	}
	return nil
}

type mappingFakeBackend struct {
	t                           *testing.T
	current                     mappingSnapshot
	events                      *[]string
	persisted                   func() mappingLedger
	creates, removes, snapshots int
	createErr, removeErr        error
	createResource              bool
	leaveResource               bool
	snapshotErrors              map[int]error
}

func mappingPublishForTest(snapshot *mappingSnapshot, ledger mappingLedger) {
	snapshot.Rows = append(snapshot.Rows, mappingRow{LocalPath: ledger.LocalPath, RemotePath: ledger.RemotePath})
	snapshot.Connections[ledger.LocalPath] = mappingConnection{RemotePath: ledger.RemotePath}
	snapshot.Devices[ledger.LocalPath] = []string{"owned native target"}
	snapshot.LogicalDrives |= 1 << uint(ledger.LocalPath[0]-'A')
}

func mappingEraseForTest(snapshot *mappingSnapshot, ledger mappingLedger) {
	rows := []mappingRow{}
	for _, row := range snapshot.Rows {
		if row.LocalPath != ledger.LocalPath || row.RemotePath != ledger.RemotePath {
			rows = append(rows, row)
		}
	}
	snapshot.Rows = rows
	snapshot.Connections[ledger.LocalPath] = mappingConnection{Status: 2250}
	snapshot.Devices[ledger.LocalPath] = nil
	snapshot.LogicalDrives &^= 1 << uint(ledger.LocalPath[0]-'A')
}

func (b *mappingFakeBackend) Snapshot(context.Context) (mappingSnapshot, error) {
	b.snapshots++
	*b.events = append(*b.events, "snapshot")
	if err := b.snapshotErrors[b.snapshots]; err != nil {
		return mappingSnapshot{}, err
	}
	return cloneMappingValue(b.t, b.current), nil
}

func (b *mappingFakeBackend) Create(_ context.Context, ledger mappingLedger) error {
	b.creates++
	*b.events = append(*b.events, "create")
	durable := b.persisted()
	if durable.CreateOutcome.Knowledge != "pending" || durable.State != "intent" || durable.RemotePath != ledger.RemotePath {
		b.t.Fatal("native create preceded its durable matching pending intent")
	}
	if b.createResource {
		mappingPublishForTest(&b.current, ledger)
	}
	return b.createErr
}

func (b *mappingFakeBackend) Remove(_ context.Context, ledger mappingLedger, row mappingRow) error {
	b.removes++
	*b.events = append(*b.events, "remove")
	durable := b.persisted()
	if durable.RemoveOutcome.Knowledge != "pending" || durable.State != "remove-pending" || row.LocalPath != ledger.LocalPath || row.RemotePath != ledger.RemotePath {
		b.t.Fatal("native remove preceded durable pending state or targeted another binding")
	}
	if b.removeErr == nil && !b.leaveResource {
		mappingEraseForTest(&b.current, ledger)
	}
	return b.removeErr
}

func newMappingModel(t *testing.T) (options, *mappingFakeBackend, *mappingMemoryStore) {
	t.Helper()
	o := mappingRequestForTest(t, "create").options()
	events := []string{}
	store := &mappingMemoryStore{t: t, o: o, events: &events}
	backend := &mappingFakeBackend{t: t, current: mappingBaselineForTest(), events: &events, persisted: func() mappingLedger { return store.ledger }, createResource: true, snapshotErrors: map[int]error{}}
	return o, backend, store
}

func startMappingModel(t *testing.T) (*ownedSMBMapping, *mappingFakeBackend, *mappingMemoryStore) {
	t.Helper()
	o, backend, store := newMappingModel(t)
	mapping, err := beginSMBMapping(context.Background(), o, "rfs-"+o.FixtureNonce, 15445, backend, store, "ledger")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return mapping, backend, store
}

func mappingKnownOutcomeForTest(code uint32, quiesced bool, cause error) error {
	return &mappingOutcomeError{Cause: cause, Outcome: mappingMutation{Knowledge: "returned", Code: &code, HelperQuiesced: quiesced}}
}

func TestMappingLiveAcknowledgedCreateOwnsOnlyOneRemoval(t *testing.T) {
	mapping, backend, store := startMappingModel(t)
	want := []string{"snapshot", "intent", "create", "save:create-returned", "snapshot", "save:observed"}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(*backend.events, want) || !mapping.removeAuthority || mapping.publicationFailed || store.ledger.Version != 2 || !mappingMutationSucceeded(store.ledger.CreateOutcome) {
		t.Fatal("creation did not acknowledge durable outcome before issuing live removal authority")
	}
	if err := mapping.cleanup(context.Background()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if backend.creates != 1 || backend.removes != 1 || mapping.removeAuthority || store.ledger.State != "removed" || !mappingMutationSucceeded(store.ledger.RemoveOutcome) || !reflect.DeepEqual(backend.current, mappingBaselineForTest()) {
		t.Fatal("normal removal replayed, retained authority or changed the baseline")
	}
	if err := mapping.cleanup(context.Background()); err != nil || backend.removes != 1 {
		t.Fatal("verified removal replayed during readonly cleanup")
	}
	fresh := &ownedSMBMapping{options: mapping.options, path: "ledger", ledger: cloneMappingValue(t, store.ledger), backend: backend, store: store}
	if err := fresh.cleanup(context.Background()); err == nil || backend.removes != 1 {
		t.Fatal("fresh cleanup declared clean from terminal bytes and current absence")
	}
	mappingPublishForTest(&backend.current, store.ledger)
	if err := mapping.cleanup(context.Background()); err == nil || backend.removes != 1 {
		t.Fatal("reappeared resource was adopted or removed again")
	}
}

func TestMappingUnknownCreateRemainsQuarantinedAfterLateEffects(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"timeout-empty", "timeout-visible", "not-invoked", "nonzero-return", "success-unquiesced"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			o, backend, store := newMappingModel(t)
			original := context.DeadlineExceeded
			backend.createErr = original
			backend.createResource = mode == "timeout-visible" || mode == "success-unquiesced"
			switch mode {
			case "not-invoked":
				backend.createErr = &mappingOutcomeError{Cause: original, Outcome: mappingMutation{Knowledge: "not-invoked", HelperQuiesced: true}}
			case "nonzero-return":
				backend.createErr = mappingKnownOutcomeForTest(5, true, original)
			case "success-unquiesced":
				backend.createErr = mappingKnownOutcomeForTest(0, false, original)
			}
			mapping, err := beginSMBMapping(context.Background(), o, "rfs-"+o.FixtureNonce, 15445, backend, store, "ledger")
			if mapping == nil || !errors.Is(err, original) || mapping.removeAuthority || store.ledger.State != "quarantined" {
				t.Fatalf("uncertain create lost ownership, its cause or quarantine: %v", err)
			}
			backend.current = cloneMappingValue(t, store.ledger.Baseline)
			for range 2 {
				if err := mapping.cleanup(context.Background()); err == nil || backend.removes != 0 {
					t.Fatal("empty inventory resolved uncertain provider effects")
				}
			}
			mappingPublishForTest(&backend.current, store.ledger)
			if err := mapping.cleanup(context.Background()); err == nil || backend.removes != 0 {
				t.Fatal("late visible create authorized a compensating mutation")
			}
			reconstructed := &ownedSMBMapping{options: o, path: "ledger", ledger: cloneMappingValue(t, store.ledger), backend: backend, store: store}
			if err := reconstructed.cleanup(context.Background()); err == nil || backend.removes != 0 {
				t.Fatal("reconstruction restored mutation authority")
			}
			backend.current = cloneMappingValue(t, store.ledger.Baseline)
			if next, err := beginSMBMapping(context.Background(), o, "rfs-"+o.FixtureNonce, 15445, backend, store, "ledger"); next != nil || !errors.Is(err, os.ErrExist) || backend.creates != 1 {
				t.Fatal("empty inventory enabled a second create against the reserved ledger")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestMappingKnownCreateResultAndObservationFailureStayDistinct(t *testing.T) {
	for _, lostObservation := range []bool{false, true} {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprint(lostObservation), func(t *testing.T) {
			o, backend, store := newMappingModel(t)
			original := errors.New("independent observation failed")
			if lostObservation {
				backend.snapshotErrors[2] = original
			} else {
				backend.createErr = mappingKnownOutcomeForTest(0, true, original)
			}
			mapping, err := beginSMBMapping(context.Background(), o, "rfs-"+o.FixtureNonce, 15445, backend, store, "ledger")
			if mapping == nil || !errors.Is(err, original) || !mapping.removeAuthority || !mappingMutationSucceeded(store.ledger.CreateOutcome) {
				t.Fatal("acknowledged success plus quiescence was confused with unknown creation")
			}
			if cleanupErr := mapping.cleanup(context.Background()); cleanupErr != nil || backend.removes != 1 || !errors.Is(err, original) {
				t.Fatalf("live cleanup lost the original failure or exact one-removal authority: %v", cleanupErr)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestMappingRemoveOutcomeNeverAuthorizesReplay(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"unknown", "not-invoked", "nonzero", "success-unquiesced", "known-success-independent-error"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			mapping, backend, store := startMappingModel(t)
			original := context.DeadlineExceeded
			backend.removeErr = original
			switch mode {
			case "not-invoked":
				backend.removeErr = &mappingOutcomeError{Cause: original, Outcome: mappingMutation{Knowledge: "not-invoked", HelperQuiesced: true}}
			case "nonzero":
				backend.removeErr = mappingKnownOutcomeForTest(5, true, original)
			case "success-unquiesced":
				backend.removeErr = mappingKnownOutcomeForTest(0, false, original)
			case "known-success-independent-error":
				backend.removeErr = mappingKnownOutcomeForTest(0, true, original)
			}
			if err := mapping.cleanup(context.Background()); !errors.Is(err, original) || backend.removes != 1 || mapping.removeAuthority {
				t.Fatalf("remove lost its failure or consumed authority: %v", err)
			}
			backend.current = cloneMappingValue(t, store.ledger.Baseline)
			for index, owned := range []*ownedSMBMapping{mapping, {options: mapping.options, path: "ledger", ledger: cloneMappingValue(t, store.ledger), backend: backend, store: store}} {
				err := owned.cleanup(context.Background())
				if (err == nil) != (index == 0 && mode == "known-success-independent-error") || backend.removes != 1 {
					t.Fatal("absence cleared uncertain removal or caused a second remove")
				}
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestMappingPublicationFailureRevokesAuthorityEvenAfterTargetChanges(t *testing.T) {
	for _, publishBeforeError := range []bool{false, true} {
		for failAt := 1; failAt <= 5; failAt++ {
			t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("save-%d-published-%v", failAt, publishBeforeError), func(t *testing.T) {
				o, backend, store := newMappingModel(t)
				store.saveErrAt, store.publishBeforeError = failAt, publishBeforeError
				mapping, err := beginSMBMapping(context.Background(), o, "rfs-"+o.FixtureNonce, 15445, backend, store, "ledger")
				if failAt > 2 {
					if err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
					err = mapping.cleanup(context.Background())
				}
				if mapping == nil || !errors.Is(err, syscall.EIO) || !mapping.publicationFailed || mapping.removeAuthority {
					t.Fatalf("publication error retained live removal authority: %v", err)
				}
				if publishBeforeError {
					states := []string{"", "create-returned", "observed", "remove-pending", "remove-returned", "removed"}
					if store.ledger.State != states[failAt] {
						t.Fatal("publication-failure fixture did not actually change its target")
					}
				}
				priorRemoves := backend.removes
				if failAt <= 3 && priorRemoves != 0 || failAt > 3 && priorRemoves != 1 {
					t.Fatal("mutation was dispatched before pending-save acknowledgement")
				}
				if err := mapping.cleanup(context.Background()); err == nil || backend.removes != priorRemoves {
					t.Fatal("same-process cleanup recovered authority from a failed publication")
				}
				reconstructed := &ownedSMBMapping{options: o, path: "ledger", ledger: cloneMappingValue(t, store.ledger), backend: backend, store: store}
				if err := reconstructed.cleanup(context.Background()); err == nil || reconstructed.removeAuthority || backend.removes != priorRemoves || backend.creates != 1 {
					t.Fatal("published terminal bytes gave a fresh object mutation authority")
				}
			})
		}
	}
}

func mappingPrivateDirectoryForTest(t *testing.T) string {
	t.Helper()
	directory := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "private")
	if err := createPrivateDirectory(directory); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return directory
}

func TestMappingDiskPublishedTerminalThenErrorCannotAuthorizeRemoval(t *testing.T) {
	for _, failAt := range []int{1, 2, 4, 5} {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("publish-%d", failAt), func(t *testing.T) {
			o := mappingRequestForTest(t, "create").options()
			path := filepath.Join(mappingPrivateDirectoryForTest(t), "smb-mapping.json")
			store := &diskMappingStore{path: path, o: o}
			publications := 0
			store.publish = func(from, to string) error {
				publications++
				if err := replaceMappingFile(from, to); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				if publications == failAt {
					return syscall.EIO
				}
				return nil
			}
			events := []string{}
			backend := &mappingFakeBackend{t: t, current: mappingBaselineForTest(), events: &events, createResource: true, snapshotErrors: map[int]error{}, persisted: func() mappingLedger {
				ledger, err := readMappingLedger(path, o)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				return ledger
			}}
			mapping, err := beginSMBMapping(context.Background(), o, "rfs-"+o.FixtureNonce, 15445, backend, store, path)
			if failAt > 2 {
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				err = mapping.cleanup(context.Background())
			}
			if mapping == nil || !errors.Is(err, syscall.EIO) || mapping.removeAuthority || !mapping.publicationFailed || backend.creates != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("published rename error did not revoke authority: %v", err)
			}
			published, err := readMappingLedger(path, o)
			if err != nil || !mappingMutationSucceeded(published.CreateOutcome) || published.State != map[int]string{1: "create-returned", 2: "observed", 4: "remove-returned", 5: "removed"}[failAt] {
				t.Fatalf("the actual disk target did not contain the acknowledged-looking terminal record: %+v %v", published, err)
			}
			wantRemoves := 0
			if failAt > 2 {
				wantRemoves = 1
				if !mappingMutationSucceeded(published.RemoveOutcome) || !reflect.DeepEqual(backend.current, mappingBaselineForTest()) {
					t.Fatal("published remove terminal fixture did not have complete absence")
				}
			}
			if err := mapping.cleanup(context.Background()); err == nil || backend.removes != wantRemoves {
				t.Fatal("same-process cleanup removed after actual target publication failed")
			}
			reopenedStore := &diskMappingStore{path: path, o: o, expected: published}
			reconstructed := &ownedSMBMapping{options: o, path: path, ledger: published, backend: backend, store: reopenedStore}
			if err := reconstructed.cleanup(context.Background()); err == nil || backend.removes != wantRemoves || backend.creates != 1 {
				t.Fatal("read-back terminal bytes authorized mutation in fresh cleanup")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestNativeMappingOutcomeSeparatesAPIFactsFromProcessErrors(t *testing.T) {
	request := mappingRequestForTest(t, "create")
	frame := mappingResultFrameForTest(t, mappingReturnedResultForTest(t, request, 0))
	failure := errors.New("independent process failure")
	for _, mode := range []string{"process-error", "context-expired", "cleanup-unknown", "owner-error", "missing-frame", "exit-zero-without-frame", "not-started", "reply-without-start", "nonzero-return"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
			defer cancel()
			execution := mappingExecution{Stdout: append([]byte(nil), frame...), Diagnostic: mappingCommandDiagnostic{StartAttempted: true, CleanupConfirmed: true}}
			var commandErr, ownerErr error
			wantKnowledge, wantCode, wantClean := "returned", uint32(0), true
			switch mode {
			case "process-error":
				commandErr = failure
			case "context-expired":
				cancel()
			case "cleanup-unknown":
				execution.Diagnostic.CleanupConfirmed, wantClean = false, false
				commandErr = failure
			case "owner-error":
				ownerErr, wantKnowledge = failure, "unknown"
			case "missing-frame":
				execution.Stdout, commandErr, wantKnowledge = nil, failure, "unknown"
			case "exit-zero-without-frame":
				execution.Stdout, wantKnowledge = nil, "unknown"
			case "not-started":
				execution.Stdout, execution.Diagnostic.StartAttempted, commandErr, wantKnowledge = nil, false, failure, "not-invoked"
			case "reply-without-start":
				execution.Diagnostic.StartAttempted, wantKnowledge = false, "not-invoked"
			case "nonzero-return":
				execution.Stdout = mappingResultFrameForTest(t, mappingReturnedResultForTest(t, request, 5))
				wantCode = 5
			}
			_, err := finishMappingCommand(ctx, request, execution, commandErr, ownerErr)
			var outcome *mappingOutcomeError
			if err == nil || !errors.As(err, &outcome) || outcome.Outcome.Knowledge != wantKnowledge || outcome.Outcome.HelperQuiesced != wantClean {
				t.Fatalf("operation knowledge was conflated with process success: outcome=%+v error=%v", outcome, err)
			}
			if commandErr != nil && !errors.Is(err, commandErr) || ownerErr != nil && !errors.Is(err, ownerErr) || mode == "context-expired" && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
				t.Fatal("bound final reply erased an independent failure")
			}
			if wantKnowledge == "returned" {
				if outcome.Outcome.Code == nil || *outcome.Outcome.Code != wantCode {
					t.Fatal("observed API return status was lost")
				}
			} else if outcome.Outcome.Code != nil {
				t.Fatal("unknown or uninvoked operation fabricated an API status")
			}
			if mappingMutationSucceeded(outcome.Outcome) != (wantKnowledge == "returned" && wantCode == 0 && wantClean) {
				t.Fatal("mutation success ignored call status or helper quiescence")
			}
		})
	}
	if _, err := finishMappingCommand(context.Background(), request, mappingExecution{Stdout: frame, Diagnostic: mappingCommandDiagnostic{StartAttempted: true, CleanupConfirmed: true}}, nil, nil); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("complete successful frame with known cleanup was rejected: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestMappingRunnerRootAndOwnerNamespaceAreFixed(t *testing.T) {
	root, err := filepath.Abs(filepath.Join("checkout", ".tmp", "native-current-authority-fixture"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	o := mappingRequestForTest(t, "inventory").options()
	o.StateFile = filepath.Join(root, "windows-runs", o.RunID, "evidence", "probe-state.json")
	executable := filepath.Join(root, "artifact", "host", "probe-windows-arm64.exe")
	if got, err := mappingRootFromExecutable(executable, o); err != nil || got != root {
		t.Fatalf("canonical executable/state identity failed: root=%q error=%v", got, err)
	}
	for _, changed := range []string{filepath.Join(root, "other.exe"), filepath.Join(root, "artifact", "probe-windows-arm64.exe"), "probe-windows-arm64.exe"} {
		if _, err := mappingRootFromExecutable(changed, o); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("another artifact location selected an independent admission namespace")
		}
	}
	foreign := o
	foreign.RunID = "124-1"
	if _, err := mappingRootFromExecutable(executable, foreign); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("state path escaped its exact run directory")
	}
	owner := mappingOwnerForTest()
	directory := mappingOwnerDirectory(root, owner)
	for _, changed := range []mappingOwner{{SID: "S-1-5-21-10-20-30-2002", AuthenticationID: owner.AuthenticationID, WindowsBuild: owner.WindowsBuild}, {SID: owner.SID, AuthenticationID: "0000000000000999", WindowsBuild: owner.WindowsBuild}} {
		if mappingOwnerDirectory(root, changed) == directory {
			t.Fatal("different SID/logon contexts share an owner claim")
		}
	}
	values := map[string]string{"GITHUB_ACTIONS": "true", "RFS_FIXTURE_RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT": "github-hosted", "GITHUB_RUN_ID": "123", "GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT": "1"}
	lookup := func(name string) string { return values[name] }
	if _, err := mappingRunnerFacts(lookup, "123-1"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, test := range []struct{ name, value string }{{"GITHUB_ACTIONS", "false"}, {"RFS_FIXTURE_RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT", "self-hosted"}, {"GITHUB_RUN_ID", "0123"}, {"GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT", "0"}, {"GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT", "2"}} {
		original := values[test.name]
		values[test.name] = test.value
		if _, err := mappingRunnerFacts(lookup, "123-1"); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("unsupported or foreign runner declaration authorized admission")
		}
		values[test.name] = original
	}
}

func TestMappingOwnerClaimRemainsConsumedAcrossRunsAndPartialInitialization(t *testing.T) {
	for _, state := range []string{"complete", "missing-claim", "malformed-claim"} {
		t.Run(state, func(t *testing.T) {
			root := mappingPrivateDirectoryForTest(t)
			request := mappingRequestForTest(t, "create")
			claim := mappingExpectedClaim(request.options(), request.Owner, mappingRunner{Environment: "github-hosted", RunID: "123", Attempt: "1"})
			directory := mappingOwnerDirectory(root, request.Owner)
			if state == "complete" {
				if err := createMappingClaim(directory, claim); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if err := validateMappingClaim(directory, claim); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			} else {
				if err := createPrivateDirectory(directory); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if state == "malformed-claim" {
					file, err := os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(directory, "claim.json"), os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0600)
					if err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
					if err := makePrivateFile(file.Name()); err != nil {
						t.Fatal(errors.Join(err, file.Close()))
					}
					_, writeErr := file.WriteString("{incomplete")
					if err := errors.Join(writeErr, file.Sync(), file.Close()); err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
				}
				if err := validateMappingClaim(directory, claim); err == nil {
					t.Fatal("partial claim initialization was adopted")
				}
			}
			other := claim
			other.RunID, other.SourceSHA, other.Nonce = "124-1", strings.Repeat("c", 40), strings.Repeat("d", 64)
			if err := createMappingClaim(mappingOwnerDirectory(root, other.Owner), other); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("new run/source/nonce reset the root/logon's consumed attempt")
			}
			if state == "complete" {
				if err := validateMappingClaim(directory, claim); err != nil {
					t.Fatal("denied admission changed the immutable original claim")
				}
				unlock, err := lockMappingOwner(directory)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				second, secondErr := lockMappingOwner(directory)
				if second != nil {
					t.Fatal(errors.Join(errors.New("second owner lock was admitted"), second(), unlock()))
				}
				unlockErr := unlock()
				if secondErr == nil {
					t.Fatal("owner lock failed to exclude concurrent admission")
				}
				if unlockErr != nil {
					t.Fatal(unlockErr)
				}
				if err := createMappingClaim(directory, claim); err == nil {
					t.Fatal("releasing the transient lock reset the immutable attempt claim")
				}
			}
		})
	}
}

type mappingTestInput struct {
	bytes.Buffer
	writes, closes int
	write          func([]byte) (int, error)
	onClose        func()
}

func (w *mappingTestInput) Write(data []byte) (int, error) {
	w.writes++
	if w.write != nil {
		return w.write(data)
	}
	return w.Buffer.Write(data)
}
func (w *mappingTestInput) Close() error {
	w.closes++
	if w.onClose != nil {
		w.onClose()
	}
	return nil
}

type mappingTestChild struct {
	input             *mappingTestInput
	output, stderr    io.ReadCloser
	done              chan struct{}
	result, finishErr error
	forced            bool
	finished, results int
}

func (p *mappingTestChild) Input() io.WriteCloser { return p.input }
func (p *mappingTestChild) Output() io.ReadCloser { return p.output }
func (p *mappingTestChild) Errors() io.ReadCloser { return p.stderr }
func (p *mappingTestChild) Done() <-chan struct{} { return p.done }
func (p *mappingTestChild) PID() uint32           { return 55 }
func (p *mappingTestChild) Result() error {
	select {
	case <-p.done:
	default:
		panic("Result observed before child exit")
	}
	p.results++
	return p.result
}
func (p *mappingTestChild) Finish() (bool, error) {
	p.finished++
	select {
	case <-p.done:
	default:
		close(p.done)
	}
	return p.forced, errors.Join(p.finishErr, p.input.Close(), p.output.Close(), p.stderr.Close())
}

type mappingTestHost struct {
	child       child
	startErr    error
	starts      int
	args, env   []string
	returnChild bool
}

func (h *mappingTestHost) Preflight() (map[string]any, error) { return nil, nil }
func (h *mappingTestHost) StartWithEnvironment(_ string, args []string, _ string, environment []string) (child, error) {
	h.starts++
	h.args, h.env = append([]string(nil), args...), append([]string(nil), environment...)
	if h.startErr != nil && !h.returnChild {
		return nil, h.startErr
	}
	return h.child, h.startErr
}

type mappingErrorReader struct{ cause error }

func (r mappingErrorReader) Read([]byte) (int, error) { return 0, r.cause }

func TestNativeMappingExecutorRetainsFrameProgressAndAllOwnedErrors(t *testing.T) {
	request := mappingRequestForTest(t, "create")
	frame := mappingResultFrameForTest(t, mappingReturnedResultForTest(t, request, 0))
	childFailure, streamFailure, cleanupFailure, writeFailure := errors.New("child failure"), errors.New("stream failure"), errors.New("cleanup failure"), errors.New("write failure")
	for _, mode := range []string{"success", "child-stream-cleanup", "short-write", "write-error", "forced"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			process := &mappingTestChild{input: &mappingTestInput{}, output: io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(frame)), stderr: io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader("")), done: make(chan struct{})}
			close(process.done)
			var want []error
			switch mode {
			case "child-stream-cleanup":
				process.result, process.finishErr = childFailure, cleanupFailure
				process.stderr = io.NopCloser(mappingErrorReader{streamFailure})
				want = []error{childFailure, streamFailure, cleanupFailure}
			case "short-write":
				process.input.write = func(data []byte) (int, error) { return len(data) - 1, nil }
				want = []error{io.ErrShortWrite}
			case "write-error":
				process.input.write = func([]byte) (int, error) { return 0, writeFailure }
				want = []error{writeFailure}
			case "forced":
				process.forced = true
			}
			host := &mappingTestHost{child: process}
			parent := append([]string(nil), os.Environ()...)
			execution, err := executeNativeMapping(context.Background(), host, "verified-probe.exe", "private-work", request)
			d := execution.Diagnostic
			if (err == nil) != (mode == "success") || host.starts != 1 || !reflect.DeepEqual(host.args, []string{"--mapping-helper"}) || !reflect.DeepEqual(parent, host.env) || !reflect.DeepEqual(parent, os.Environ()) {
				t.Fatalf("native helper changed process invocation/environment or erased failure: %v", err)
			}
			for _, cause := range want {
				if !errors.Is(err, cause) {
					t.Fatalf("owned operation lost a failure: %v", err)
				}
			}
			if !d.StartAttempted || d.PID == nil || *d.PID != 55 || d.WorkersStarted != 3 || d.WorkersJoined != 3 || process.finished != 1 || process.input.writes != 1 || process.input.closes != 1 || !bytes.Equal(execution.Stdout, frame) || d.CleanupConfirmed != (mode != "child-stream-cleanup") {
				t.Fatal("executor returned before all workers/owner cleanup or lost complete captured bytes")
			}
			input := mappingRequestFrameForTest(t, request)
			if d.InputBytes != len(input) || d.InputSHA256 != fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(input)) || d.InputLineBytes != len(input)-1 || d.InputLineSHA256 != fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(input[:len(input)-1])) {
				t.Fatal("executor confused framed and unframed request bytes")
			}
			if mode == "success" && (!d.WriteComplete || !bytes.Equal(process.input.Bytes(), input)) {
				t.Fatal("successful helper did not receive exactly one unchanged frame")
			}
		})
	}
}

type mappingControlledReader struct {
	data        *bytes.Reader
	ready, done chan struct{}
	readOnce    sync.Once
	closeOnce   sync.Once
}

func newMappingControlledReader(data []byte) *mappingControlledReader {
	return &mappingControlledReader{data: bytes.NewReader(data), ready: make(chan struct{}), done: make(chan struct{})}
}
func (r *mappingControlledReader) Read(buffer []byte) (int, error) {
	r.readOnce.Do(func() { close(r.ready) })
	if n, err := r.data.Read(buffer); n > 0 || err != io.EOF {
		return n, err
	}
	<-r.done
	return 0, io.EOF
}
func (r *mappingControlledReader) Close() error { r.closeOnce.Do(func() { close(r.done) }); return nil }

type mappingDeadlineContext struct{ context.Context }

func (c mappingDeadlineContext) Err() error {
	if c.Context.Err() != nil {
		return context.DeadlineExceeded
	}
	return nil
}

func TestNativeMappingTimeoutJoinsWorkersWithoutInventingCompletion(t *testing.T) {
	request := mappingRequestForTest(t, "create")
	for _, complete := range []bool{false, true} {
		for _, cleanupFailed := range []bool{false, true} {
			t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("complete-%v-cleanup-failed-%v", complete, cleanupFailed), func(t *testing.T) {
				frame := mappingResultFrameForTest(t, mappingReturnedResultForTest(t, request, 0))
				if !complete {
					frame = frame[:len(frame)/2]
				}
				stdout, stderr := newMappingControlledReader(frame), newMappingControlledReader([]byte("native stderr evidence"))
				base, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Second)
				defer cancel()
				ctx := mappingDeadlineContext{Context: base}
				inputClosed := make(chan struct{})
				input := &mappingTestInput{onClose: func() { close(inputClosed) }}
				input.write = func(data []byte) (int, error) {
					for _, ready := range []<-chan struct{}{stdout.ready, stderr.ready} {
						select {
						case <-ready:
						case <-inputClosed:
							return 0, io.ErrClosedPipe
						}
					}
					n, err := input.Buffer.Write(data)
					cancel()
					return n, err
				}
				process := &mappingTestChild{input: input, output: stdout, stderr: stderr, done: make(chan struct{}), forced: true}
				cleanupError := errors.New("owned Job cleanup failed")
				if cleanupFailed {
					process.finishErr = cleanupError
				}
				execution, err := executeNativeMapping(ctx, &mappingTestHost{child: process}, "verified-probe.exe", "private-work", request)
				d := execution.Diagnostic
				if !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) || cleanupFailed && !errors.Is(err, cleanupError) || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), context.DeadlineExceeded.Error()) || process.finished != 1 || process.results != 0 || input.closes != 1 {
					t.Fatalf("timeout lost original errors or fabricated an earlier exit: %v", err)
				}
				if d.PreCleanupDone == nil || *d.PreCleanupDone || d.PreCleanupResult != nil || d.WorkersStarted != 3 || d.WorkersJoined != 3 || d.CleanupConfirmed == cleanupFailed || !d.CleanupForced || !bytes.Equal(execution.Stdout, frame) {
					t.Fatal("timeout observations preceded owned worker completion")
				}
				_, err = finishMappingCommand(ctx, request, execution, err, nil)
				var outcome *mappingOutcomeError
				if !errors.As(err, &outcome) || (outcome.Outcome.Knowledge == "returned") != complete || outcome.Outcome.HelperQuiesced == cleanupFailed {
					t.Fatal("process termination supplied missing operation knowledge or erased a complete bound frame")
				}
			})
		}
	}
}

type mappingWriterFunc func([]byte) (int, error)

func (w mappingWriterFunc) Write(data []byte) (int, error) { return w(data) }

func TestNativeMappingLostFinalWriteRemainsUnknownToParent(t *testing.T) {
	for _, short := range []bool{false, true} {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprint(short), func(t *testing.T) {
			request := mappingRequestForTest(t, "remove")
			ops := mappingSnapshotOpsForTest(t, mappingSnapshotForRequestForTest(request))
			mutations := 0
			ops.Cancel = func(string, uint32, bool) uint32 { mutations++; return 0 }
			services := mappingHelperServices{Owner: func() (mappingOwner, error) { return request.Owner, nil }, Job: func() error { return nil }, Authorize: func(mappingCommandRequest) (mappingLedger, error) {
				return mappingLedgerForRequestForTest(request), nil
			}, Native: ops}
			failure := errors.New("final pipe write failed")
			var captured bytes.Buffer
			writer := mappingWriterFunc(func(data []byte) (int, error) {
				if short {
					return captured.Write(data[:len(data)-1])
				}
				return 0, failure
			})
			err := runMappingHelperWith(nil, bytes.NewReader(mappingRequestFrameForTest(t, request)), writer, services)
			want := failure
			if short {
				want = io.ErrShortWrite
			}
			if !errors.Is(err, want) || mutations != 1 {
				t.Fatal("lost reply retried mutation or hid the write error")
			}
			_, err = finishMappingCommand(context.Background(), request, mappingExecution{Stdout: captured.Bytes(), Diagnostic: mappingCommandDiagnostic{StartAttempted: true, CleanupConfirmed: true}}, err, nil)
			var outcome *mappingOutcomeError
			if !errors.As(err, &outcome) || outcome.Outcome.Knowledge != "unknown" || outcome.Outcome.Code != nil || !errors.Is(err, want) {
				t.Fatal("actual helper-side return or clean termination replaced a missing complete final frame")
			}
		})
	}
}

type mappingReadOnlyReader struct{ io.Reader }

func TestNativeMappingCaptureAndDiagnosticBoundsRemainFailClosed(t *testing.T) {
	var capture mappingBoundedBuffer
	data := strings.Repeat("x", mappingByteLimit+16)
	n, err := io.Copy(&capture, mappingReadOnlyReader{strings.NewReader(data)})
	if err == nil || n != mappingByteLimit || capture.Len() != mappingByteLimit {
		t.Fatal("io.Copy bypassed the native helper output bound")
	}
	facts := capture.diagnostic()
	prefix, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(facts.PrefixBase64)
	if err != nil || facts.ObservedBytes != int64(len(data)) || !facts.PrefixTruncated || len(prefix) != 2048 || string(prefix) != data[:2048] {
		t.Fatal("bounded capture hid truncation or lost actual byte counts")
	}
	stream := mappingStreamDiagnostic{ObservedBytes: mappingByteLimit + 16, PrefixBase64: base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(make([]byte, 2048)), PrefixTruncated: true}
	resultText := strings.Repeat("\x00", 512)
	diagnostic := mappingCommandDiagnostic{Action: strings.Repeat("\x00", 64), WriteError: strings.Repeat("\x00", 512), PreCleanupResult: &resultText, Stdout: stream, Stderr: stream}
	var bounded *mappingDiagnosticError
	if err := encodeMappingDiagnostic(diagnostic); !errors.As(err, &bounded) || len(bounded.Error()) >= 16<<10 {
		t.Fatal("bounded native diagnostic no longer fits its existing error envelope")
	}
	diagnostic.WriteError = strings.Repeat("x", 20<<10)
	if err := encodeMappingDiagnostic(diagnostic); err == nil || errors.As(err, &bounded) {
		t.Fatal("oversized diagnostic silently truncated required facts")
	}
	for _, raw := range []string{`{"version":1,"version":1}`, `{"rows":[{"local_path":"Z:","local_path":"Y:"}]}`, `{} {}`, strings.Repeat("[", 18) + strings.Repeat("]", 18), strings.Repeat(" ", mappingByteLimit+1)} {
		var value any
		if err := decodeMappingJSON([]byte(raw), &value); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("ambiguous or oversized native JSON was accepted")
		}
	}
}
